description: Cases for behaviour that version 1 of the language defines, which a conforming implementation must pass. Expected results were derived from the decisions of the specification. A case with dependsOnChoice true rests on a detail listed in choices; reconcile it when the specification settles that detail. Unless a choice says otherwise, a case that expects an error also assumes no follow-on diagnostic is reported for a name whose own declaration failed.

mayChange.reason: Version 1 gives Result two type arguments (value and error type).
Version 1 makes Result a sum type, which changes both the type and its rendering.
Version 1 reserves further words (enum, test and assert), and the number of diagnostics for a misplaced reserved word is not settled.
